notes.title: Winter's Empty Mask is finally here!
notes.notes:
The Long-awaited moment is here! I Hope you enjoy the game. Thank you so much for following us for so long, this is certainly our biggest and longest project, but I think it was worth it. I hope you think the same once you play it.

notes.title: Winter's Empty Mask demo - 2019
notes.notes:
Hello! Today I have great news to share with you, over the past year we, Eternal Night Studios, have been working on a new game called "Winter's empty mask." and we are getting close to completion. There is currently a demo out for all of you to check. This is our biggest project to date and I wholeheartedly hope you enjoy it. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30187569/588f7a3d4d1f29d1b32101e78a8e5adca61c0d9a.png[/img]

You can download the demo in the link bellow. for more information you can visit our [url=https://www.facebook.com/eternal.night.studios/]Facebook[/url]

[url=https://www.facebook.com/eternal.night.studios/photos/a.530512170431051/1198338650315063/?type=3&theater]Winter'sDEMO[/url]

There are just a few days left for the Kickstarter and it seems that reaching our goal will not be possible. However we do not think on giving up, Eternal Night Studios has already taken the next step, in this case opening a "Patreon". Patreon is a service where people subscribe to donate a certain amount of money each month to artists or developers who they believe deserve it, and in return receive a reward. 

If you like our work and would like to help us continue with it, please consider subscribing. We would be very grateful. 

You can see our Patreon page in the following link. See you next time.

notes.title: Next project on Kickstarter
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Stw here.

As many of you have guessed, Winter’s empty mask is the next project we are working on. Currently this project has the storyline already written, but we are planning to add more routes to complement the story and increase the duration of the novel, making it more extensive than any of our previous works.

Soon we will be posting the demo’s update, including Chapter 2 along with the respective translations into Spanish, English and Russian. We will also launch the Kickstarter campaign to finance the novel, so we hope you can support us through either, direct funding of the project or through spreading the news to potential contributors.

That would be all for now, see you next week, the most important day for all members of "Eternal Night Studios"

Have a nice day.

notes.title: Welcome to Connected Hearts
notes.notes:
If you have previously downloaded the game from itch.io and now want to play it on steam, you may experience a bug with the achievements. This is caused by the conflicting save files and to fix it you most delete them. I must warn you, you will lose all of your previous progress. 

First go to:

AppData\Roaming\RenPy\Connected Hearts-1483484046

And delete all files inside that folder. Then go to:

Program Files\Steam\steamapps\common\Connected Hearts - Visual novel\game\cache

Program Files\Steam\steamapps\common\Connected Hearts - Visual novel\game\saves

And once again delete all files on both folders. 

Once you have done that re-run steam and check if you have any saved games. If you have none then you can play freely Connected Hearts and the achievements will unlock as you progress like normal. 

Enjoy! 

----------------------------------------------------------------------

Si ya has jugado "Connected Hearts" previamente en Itch.io y ahora deseas desbloquear todos los logros en steam, debes de seguir algunos pasos extras para que los logros se activen. De ante mano te informo que tus partidas serán borradas y comenzaras de nuevo.
Primero encuentra la carpeta:

AppData\Roaming\RenPy\Connected Hearts-1483484046

Borra todos los archivos en esa carpeta. Luego ve a las capetas:

Program Files\Steam\steamapps\common\Connected Hearts - Visual novel\game\cache

Program Files\Steam\steamapps\common\Connected Hearts - Visual novel\game\saves

Una vez más borra todos los archivos en esas carpetas
 
Listo, ahora ejecuta Connected Hearts. Los logros se irán desbloqueando a medida que avances en la historia.

¡Que se diviertan!
